observations: Photo 0: A white Casio keyboard wrapped in plastic, placed on a tiled floor. The brand 'CASIO' is visible on the left side of the control panel. The keyboard has 61 keys, standard for most portable keyboards. The control panel includes a small screen, knobs, and buttons. The plastic wrap is intact, suggesting minimal use or new condition.
Photo 1: The same keyboard placed on a black X-style keyboard stand. The plastic wrap is still on, covering the keys and control panel. The stand appears to be standard and functional.

Photo 2: Close-up of the right side of the keyboard, showing the 'CASIO' logo in large letters. Ports are visible: power input, headphone jack, and possibly MIDI or USB. The plastic wrap is still present, covering the keys and part of the panel. The keyboard appears to be in a clean, unused condition.

claims.claim: A clean Casio keyboard for personal rehearsal, worship and devotional.
claims.evidence: The keyboard is wrapped in plastic, appears clean, and the brand 'Casio' is clearly visible in photo 0 and photo 2. The context of use (rehearsal, worship) is plausible for this type of instrument.

risks.risk: The keyboard may not be functional (e.g., keys not working, no sound, or internal damage).
risks.proof: A video clip showing the keyboard powered on, keys pressed, and sound produced, or a photo of the power indicator lit and a note played.

risks.risk: The keyboard may be missing accessories (e.g., power adapter, sustain pedal, or original stand).
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the keyboard.

risks.risk: The plastic wrap may be old or damaged, indicating prior use or storage issues.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the plastic wrap showing any tears, dust, or signs of age.

proof_requests: Video clip of the keyboard powered on and playing a note to confirm functionality.
Photo of all included accessories (power adapter, stand, etc.).
Close-up of the plastic wrap to check for damage or age.
response.reason: The keyboard is clearly a Casio model and appears clean and wrapped, but functionality and included accessories cannot be confirmed from the photos alone. Without proof of working condition and accessories, the item cannot be priced accurately.
